name: Angel Smoothie
source:
Welcome to Demon Land!

Us demonkind call it home. Cast down from the skies, a pure white angel descended.

The demonlord extended an olive branch to her, and now she lives among us

selling smoothies

[From [url=https://daun-kompak.itch.io/angel-smoothie]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到恶魔之地！

我们恶魔一族把这里当作家园。某天，一位纯白的天使遭到天界放逐，降落于此。

魔王向她伸出橄榄枝，如今她就生活在我们中间，

卖着冰沙。

[摘自[url=https://daun-kompak.itch.io/angel-smoothie]Itch.io[/url]]
